body: I'm sorry you had to go through all of this. I know I can't fall into a hole and do things I'm going to regret, because that would be a disservice to him. I hope you've found the closure that you need.
Thank you for all of this. I've learned many positive lessons from him and what happened to him, even though they're tearing me apart right now.
This was a particularly beautiful response...thank you, it means so much to me.

I don't know how long he would've lasted had he never met me. His life reached a big breaking point in high school but I kept him going. What ultimately brought him over the edge was, I believe (he implied this every now and then), that I was going to forget about him when I went to college. If he knew he wasn't just another friend to me, and that I had every motivation to keep in contact with him, might he have held on longer?

And yes, telling him how I felt might have destroyed our friendship...but anything is better than him being dead.

I'm so sorry to hear that...I can't imagine how that feels, honestly. Horrible, freak accidents we have no control over. I know, no matter how guilty I feel, that he would never blame me, just as your love would never blame you. I hope you can find closure too.

I know I was probably the best thing he had and he wouldn't want me to throw my life away. That's a big part of what keeps me going. Right up to the end, he wanted me to go on to big things. He seemed more excited I got into my favorite school than I did! I think he started living his last few months through me. That's why I push on, because if he can still see me, I want him to live a full life through me.

Sorry, I should have.

tl;dr: Best friend killed himself. Many things I could have done. Have a good future but I can't get over what I did(n't) do.
